items.exampleEn: The singer hoped her songs would live on eternally.
items.exampleZh: 那位歌手希望她的歌能永遠流傳下去。

items.exampleEn: Buying a house gave them a sense of permanence.
items.exampleZh: 買了房子讓他們有種安定長久的感覺。

items.exampleEn: The two old friends made an everlasting promise to stay in touch.
items.exampleZh: 兩位老朋友許下永遠保持聯絡的承諾。

items.exampleEn: The actress seems ageless; she looks the same as twenty years ago.
items.exampleZh: 那位女演員好像不會老，看起來和二十年前一樣。

items.exampleEn: In this job, the timeliness of your reports matters a lot.
items.exampleZh: 在這份工作中，報告是否及時交出非常重要。

items.exampleEn: The company values punctuality, so do not be late.
items.exampleZh: 公司很重視守時，所以不要遲到。

items.exampleEn: His invariable answer to every question is "maybe."
items.exampleZh: 他對每個問題的回答一成不變，都是「也許」。

items.sentenceEn: Punctuality is the first thing our new manager checks.
items.sentenceZh: 守時是我們新經理最先檢查的事。

items.audioEn: Thank you so much for helping me move. I'm eternally grateful!
items.audioZh: 非常謝謝你幫我搬家。我會永遠感激你！
options: The listener helped with the move
The listener paid for dinner last night
The listener fixed the car for free

items.sentenceEn: In a world that changes so fast, nothing has real permanence.
items.sentenceZh: 在變化這麼快的世界裡，沒有什麼是真正永久的。

items.sentenceEn: My grandmother's ageless smile always makes me feel at home.
items.sentenceZh: 奶奶那不會老的笑容，總讓我覺得很自在。

items.stemEn: The client was happy with the ____ of our reply; we answered within an hour.
items.stemZh: 客戶很滿意我們回覆得很及時；我們一小時內就回覆了。

items.stemEn: Her love for music was ____; she played the piano until she was ninety.
items.stemZh: 她對音樂的熱愛永不消逝；她一直彈鋼琴到九十歲。

items.passageEn: Mr. Wu has repaired watches in the same small shop for fifty years. Customers love his punctuality, and his rule is invariable: if he says a watch will be ready on Friday, it is ready on Friday. He believes that the timeliness of a repair matters as much as its quality. "A watch should have a sense of permanence," he says. "A good one is ageless and can pass from parents to children." Additionally, many customers are eternally thankful to him for saving watches that once belonged to their grandparents. For them, his small shop is a place of everlasting memories.
items.passageZh: 吳先生在同一家小店修錶已經五十年了。顧客很喜歡他的守時，而他的原則從不改變：他說星期五修好，就一定星期五修好。他認為修理是否及時和修理的品質一樣重要。他說：「一支錶應該讓人感覺可以長長久久。好錶不會過時，可以由父母傳給子女。」此外，許多顧客永遠感謝他救回了祖父母留下來的錶。對他們來說，他的小店是一個充滿永恆回憶的地方。

questions.questionZh: 顧客喜歡吳先生的哪一點？
吳先生認為修錶時，什麼和品質一樣重要？

items.promptZh: 在我們家，守時是很重要的規矩。
referenceEn: In our family, punctuality is an important rule.
Punctuality is a very important rule in my family.
rubricZh: punctuality 是名詞，可當主詞（例如 Punctuality is…）
「規矩」可寫 rule 等；「在我們家」可寫 in our family、in my family、at home 等

items.promptZh: 我奶奶永遠都那麼樂觀。
referenceEn: My grandmother is eternally optimistic about life.
My grandma is eternally cheerful and positive.
rubricZh: eternally 放在形容詞前，表示「永遠地」（例如 eternally optimistic 等）
「樂觀」可寫，例如 optimistic、positive、cheerful 等；寫不寫 about life 都可以
